{{Quote|The XLT-014 is one of the more reliable labor droids of its size that I have seen.|EV-6T6, a droid supervisor|<ref name="SGTD" />}}
The '''XLT-014 labor droid''' was a [[Loader droid/Legends|loader droid]] model produced by [[Publictechnic]] in the three [[Time/Legends|decades]] before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The XLT-014 carried relatively small loads when compared to larger [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as [[Binary loadlifter/Legends|binary loadlifters]], but XLT-014 units were able to move cargo to more places due to the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] installed in their [[Limb/Legends|feet]]. The droids had sophisticated [[Sensor/Legends|scanning equipment]] for reading labels on cargo containers and [[Cargo manifest/Legends|manifests]], but their limited intelligence sometimes caused problems for the droids' owners. During the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that the model was in production, the droids were used by small businesses, the wealthy, and corporations. Despite its intended purpose as a labor droid, the XLT-014 was also used as a servant, and in some instances the droids were modified to be [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], helpers for [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]], and even infiltrators.

==Description==
{{Quote|Despite its deceptively thin appearance, it can carry a sufficient load and last a long time.|EV-6T6, on the XLT-014's abilities|<ref name="SGTD" />}}
The XLT-014 [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] was a [[Class five droid/Legends|class five]] [[Loader droid/Legends|loader droid]] that was roughly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape&mdash;with two [[Limb/Legends|legs]], a torso, and a head. Instead of arms, it had two long, flat claw appendages for carrying cargo containers. Units of the model had [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] installed in their three-toed feet so that the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] could lift cargo to places that conventional labor droids could not; the repulsorlifts emitted a [[Color/Legends|blue]] glow when in use. The 1.5-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall droids had an outer shell made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]; one possible [[Color/Legends|color]] scheme made the droid mostly yellow in color, with the sides of the legs orange and the top of the head red. The droid model was equipped with a [[Recording rod|video recorder]] and excellent [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that were capable of scanning cargo labels and [[Cargo manifest/Legends|manifests]], as well as scanning for energy readings and lifeforms within a radius of roughly nine meters. One possible color for the [[Photoreceptor/Legends|sensor]] equipped on the head was blue.<ref name="SGTD" />

==Role==
{{Quote|Of course, now and then an XLT-014 gets a bit overconfident, reads some information too quickly, and gets into trouble by mixing up what it read.|EV-6T6, on the XLT-014 labor droid|<ref name="SGTD" />}}
An unmodified XLT-014 could perform simple tasks such as cargo lifting, simple household chores, and menial duties in offices. While their cargo lifting abilities were sufficient to be useful, they were not anywhere close to those of a larger droid, such as a [[Binary loadlifter/Legends|binary loadlifter]]. However, the XLT-014 lacked the [[Processor/Legends|processor]] required for independent thinking, and was controlled via a [[remote receiver]] installed on it. The droids of the XLT-014 model were not particularly intelligent and sometimes read too quickly, a flaw that could cause problems for their owners. A droid supervisor with the designation [[EV-6T6]] thought that the quirk stemmed from the fact that the droids had a tendency to become overconfident. In spite of the perceived drawback, EV-6T6 viewed the droid design as long-lasting and reliable. XLT-014 labor droids were also skilled in using [[Computer/Legends|computers]], and were equipped with [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulators]] that allowed the units to speak both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Binary/Legends|binary]].<ref name="SGTD" />

==History==
{{Quote|A number of XLT-014 droids are employed by the cruise line, and one of the droids on board was reprogrammed to provide the ship's computer with a wrong destination.|EV-6T6, speaking about a hijacking incident involving a XLT-014 labor droid|<ref name="SGTD" />}}
The XLT-014 labor droid was created and produced by the droid manufacturer [[Publictechnic]] during the three [[Time/Legends|decades]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="SGTD" /> which was fought from [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During that time, the droid sold for 9,600 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was available to licensed individuals. XLT-014 droids were frequently used in combination with binary loadlifters for cargo lifting jobs in order to save time for living workers. Besides their role as cargo movers in the distribution warehouses of corporations, the droids were frequently used by the wealthy as household servants and by small businesses for simple duties in offices. XLT-014 units were also modified by wealthy business people to serve as [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], which was a cheaper option than buying a new [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]]. For that task, the droids were reprogrammed and usually equipped with simple processors, hands, improved sensors, and sometimes a [[Scomp link/Legends|scomp link]] to interface directly with the flight control systems. Another popular modification was to program the droid as an assistant for [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]] by installing a [[Heuristic processor/Legends|heuristic processor]]<ref name="SGTD" /> for increased learning and creativity,<ref name="SECR 190-191">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> different appendages, and diagnostics tools, as well as a storage area capable of holding around five [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of tools. The relatively small size of the droid also inspired some individuals to alter the XLT-014 for the purposes of infiltration by giving the droid security tools, a heuristic processor, and upgrades such as improved sensors and sound dampening for the repulsorlifts.<ref name="SGTD" />

During the time of the Galactic Republic, XLT-014 labor droids served on the cruise [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Galactic Breeze]]''. [[Unidentified XLT-014 labor droid|One]] of the droids was reprogrammed to cause the starship's computer to send the ship to the wrong location. The ''Galactic Breeze'' went off course and was captured by a [[Unidentified pirate group (Galactic Breeze)|group]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]].<ref name="SGTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The XLT-014 labor droid was included in the droid codex of ''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]'', a [[2009]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|''Saga Edition'']] of the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The book was written by [[Rodney Thompson]], [[Sterling Hershey]], [[Patrick Stutzman]], and [[Robert Wieland]]. In the game, the droid was available for players to use as a template during character creation.<ref name="SGTD" />
